knowledge_point.title: Finding an Entry of a Square Matrix

question.:question/problem:
Find the entry $b_{22}$ of the matrix $B$, where
$B = \begin{bmatrix}13 & \sqrt{2} & 9 & 7 \\ 12 & -9 & -6 & -5 \\ 5 & 4 & 9 & \sqrt{3} \\ 7 & 8 & -4 & 5\end{bmatrix}$.
question.:question/worked-solution:
The entry $b_{22}$ lies at the intersection of the $2$nd row and $2$nd column. Therefore, $b_{22}=-9.$

$B = \begin{bmatrix}13 & \sqrt{2} & 9 & 7 \\ 12 & -9 & -6 & -5 \\ 5 & 4 & 9 & \sqrt{3} \\ 7 & 8 & -4 & 5\end{bmatrix}$.
